name: Membrane Group India Pvt Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: None -- the company primarily focuses on water and wastewater treatment solutions, which are not central to semiconductor manufacturing.
india_angle: Membrane Group India Pvt Ltd is a leading manufacturer and distributor for water and wastewater treatment plants and components in India.
summary: Membrane Group India Pvt Ltd specializes in providing water and wastewater treatment solutions. Their expertise lies in improving water quality and recycling wastewater for various industries, municipalities, and institutions. They do not have a direct role in the semiconductor value chain.
